description: The control under Aarseth–Zare: the same passage with the gate's reader pointed at the Cartesian read-out after the passage. The two read-outs differ on this passage (measured by the gate: 4.179e-14 regularised, 4.190e-14 Cartesian), so the value read is not the occupant's regularised drift and the reader check fails it: the Aarseth–Zare arm can fail by the reader check, which binds under both occupants (REQ-VAL-045; physics review 5895439304 of PR #522).
